用法：\n crannia channel list:
Usage:
  crannia channel list                list channel profiles and notices
  crannia channel add <platform> [name]  create a profile (credentials one by one)
  crannia channel config <name|id>    edit a profile (Enter = keep)
  crannia channel remove <name|id>    delete a profile (switch the default first)
  crannia channel default <name|id>   make it the platform's default
  crannia channel start <platform>    start a channel (backend must be running)
  crannia channel stop <platform>     stop a channel (backend must be running)
  crannia channel login wechat        WeChat QR login (backend must be running)

Platforms: feishu / dingtalk / telegram / qq_bot (credentials) · wechat (QR)
